analog.text: Re-seat or swap the cable from {device} **{port}** to {next_device} **{next_port}**.

usb.text: Check the USB cable from {device} to {next_device} and that the computer sees {device} as an audio/video input.

hdmi.text: Re-seat the HDMI cable from {device} to {next_device}; long HDMI runs often fail — try a shorter cable.

sdi.text: Check the SDI cable from {device} to {next_device} and that both ends use the same SDI rate (HD / 3G / 12G).

dante.text: In Dante Controller, check {next_device}'s subscription to {device} is green (no clock or latency errors).

snake.text: Check the digital snake link between {device} and {next_device} (link lights, cable, connectors).

rf.text: Check batteries, mute switch and RF signal on {device}; make sure it is on {next_device}'s frequency.

speaker.text: Check the speaker cable from {device} **{port}** to {next_device}.

network.text: Check the network link between {device} and {next_device} (link light, switch port, VLAN).

dmx.text: Check the DMX cable from {device} **{port}** to {next_device} and that the end of the chain is terminated.

sacn.text: Check {next_device} listens to the same sACN universe {device} sends.

power.text: Check the power feed from {device} to {next_device} (breaker, outlet, cable).

aes3.text: Check the AES3 cable from {device} **{port}** to {next_device} is 110 ohm and both ends agree on sample rate.

aes50.text: Check the AES50 link between {device} and {next_device} (shielded Cat5e, link/sync LEDs, clock master).

madi.text: Check the MADI link from {device} to {next_device} (56/64-channel mode, sample rate, connectors seated).

avb.text: Check the AVB/Milan stream from {device} to {next_device} is connected in the controller and the switch is AVB-capable.

iem_wired.text: Check the headphone/IEM cable and level from {device} to {next_device}.

iem_wireless.text: Check the IEM RF link from {device} to {next_device} (frequency, antenna, bodypack battery).

video.text: Check the video cable from {device} to {next_device} and that both ends agree on format.

aes67.text: Check the AES67 stream from {device} is received by {next_device} (PTP clock, multicast, session).

qlan.text: Check the Q-LAN connection between {device} and {next_device} (Core status, switch QoS).

adat.text: Check the ADAT optical link from {device} to {next_device} (clock source, sample rate, TOSLINK seated).

speaker_70v.text: Check the 70/100 V line from {device} to {next_device}: tap settings, line load and no shorts.

intercom.text: Check the intercom cable from {device} to {next_device} and the line power.

displayport.text: Re-seat the DisplayPort cable from {device} to {next_device} and check the source's display settings.

hdbaset.text: Check the HDBaseT link from {device} to {next_device} (link LED, Cat6 under 100 m, no couplers in the run).

fiber.text: Check the fiber from {device} to {next_device}: clean the connectors, check TX/RX polarity and the link light.

ndi.text: Check {next_device} finds the NDI source from {device} on the network (same subnet or discovery server).

st2110.text: Check the ST 2110 flows from {device} to {next_device} (PTP lock, multicast routes, SDP).

rdm.text: Check the DMX/RDM cable from {device} **{port}** to {next_device} and the termination at the end of the line.

artnet.text: Check {next_device} listens to the Art-Net universe {device} sends (net / sub-net / universe) and is in the same IP range.

rs232.text: Check the serial cable from {device} to {next_device} (TX/RX swap, baud rate, ground).

rs422.text: Check the RS-422/485 wiring from {device} to {next_device} (pairs, termination, address).

ir.text: Check the IR emitter from {device} is stuck on {next_device}'s IR window.

gpio.text: Check the contact-closure wiring from {device} **{port}** to {next_device} **{next_port}** (common, polarity).

osc.text: Check {device} sends OSC to {next_device}'s IP address and port.

midi.text: Check the MIDI cable from {device} to {next_device} and that both use the same MIDI channel.

timecode.text: Check the timecode from {device} reaches {next_device} at a usable level and frame rate.

sync.text: Check the word clock / genlock from {device} to {next_device} and that {next_device} is set to external sync.

power_dc.text: Check the DC supply from {device} to {next_device} (adapter, polarity, voltage).
